contentBlocks.heading: Network science recommends movies to watch.
contentBlocks.text:
NECSI researchers have used network theory to create a network of the top 500 movies. On NECSI’s new app, * (Star) Movies Mobile, you can use the iPhone’s or iPod’s touch screen to navigate the network and discover movies you want to see. Look up a movie you like and find its network neighbors, or rate movies and * (Star) Movies Mobile will recommend others for you to see. Then add them to your Netflix queue right from the app!

See a video tutorial at http://tinyurl.com/StarMoviesMobile
